messages:
Megan: morning handoff — quick async update from the night shift. saw repeated latency spikes on embeddings reads between 02:40-03:10 UTC, root cause looks like aggressive cache evictions on kv-cache-primary (hot key churn for session embeddings). mitigation applied: increased per-model cache quota for `embed-prod-v2` and enabled shard pinning for the top 3 workers. also rolled back quantization commit `qconv-v3` for that pool to reduce memory pressure.
Tyler: rough numbers? how bad were the spikes? any error budget burn? :eyes:
Megan: p50 stayed ~45ms, p95 jumped from 210ms to ~1.1s for about 18 mins during peak churn. no SLO breach recorded, but request queueing increased briefly. error budget unchanged. eviction rate spiked from 0.8/min to 8/min for that model.
Sasha: do we have a flame/log link for the period? want to check if KV lookups retried or backoff kicked in.
Megan: uploading logs: https://logs.redwood.example/teams/infra/streams/1963057890?from=02:30&to=03:30 — check `kv_cache.eviction_rate` and `rpc.retries`. attached a short snippet below:
```
2026-03-15T02:48:12Z kv_cache.eviction key=embed-prod-v2 worker=wk-12 rate=9
2026-03-15T02:48:13Z rpc.call latency=1123ms backend=kv-primary status=200 retries=1
2026-03-15T02:55:01Z kv_cache.eviction key=embed-prod-v2 worker=wk-03 rate=7
```
Rui: thanks. quick question on rollback: was that a manual rollback or automated fallback? need to sync with release notes.
Megan: manual. Canary alerted about memory pressure and I rolled qconv-v3 -> qconv-v2 for the dedicated pool at 03:12 UTC. Filed a follow-up PR to revert after we stabilize: https://git.redwood/infra/kv-cache/pulls/482
Anita: any follow-ups for the next shift? I can watch eu-west region until 10:00 UTC.
Megan: yes — monitor eviction_rate and p95 for `embed-prod-v2` and `embed-staging` (they share the same pool). If eviction_rate > 3/min for > 10m, escalate to infra-oncall and increase per-model cache by +15%. Also keep an eye on autoscaler logs; I disabled autoscale for the pool briefly while we evaluated.
Tyler: pinging infra SRE for quick safety net: @SRE-team (cc infra-oncall)
oncall-bot: ALERT SUMMARY (03:04 UTC): 3x latency spikes observed for embeddings reads in us-west-2. Automated mitigation recommended: bump cache_quota. Action taken: manual cache bump to embed-prod-v2 by oncall (Megan).
Sasha: small ops note — I left a short runbook snippet in the ops runbook section under 'embed cache churn': `if eviction spike then pin top-3 shards -> increase quota -> monitor 20m -> revert pins`.
Megan: thanks. last thing: code review ping that relates to autoscaler change is still blocking a follow-up fix (PR 487). Rui, can you take a look today? it touches quota calc.
Rui: on it, aiming to review by EOD. if I don't get to it, Anita can carry the hotfix.
Anita: ack. I'll keep watch and can apply the hotfix if PR lands but needs urgent deploy.
Tyler: :thumbsup: good handoff. I'll follow up if I see anything in the logs.
Megan: thanks all — handoff complete. posting final checklist:
- monitor eviction_rate (embed-prod-v2, embed-staging)
- watch p95 latency and queue depth
- keep autoscaler disabled for this pool until PR 487 reviewed
- escalate if repeat spikes >=2 within 30m
Megan: tagging the oncall doc update ticket: https://trello.redwood/board/ops/1256 (note added)
Anita: noted. shifting to active watch. :coffee:
oncall-bot: SHIFT HANDOFF recorded by Megan at 03:20 UTC. "overnight embed churn -> cache bump -> quant rollback"
